title: MCP server
description: Operational details of the MCP server in the active workspace.
connectDescription: Remote HTTP transport (Streamable HTTP). Authentication uses the organization’s OAuth 2.1 flow.
oauthNote: Authentication uses the organization’s OAuth 2.1 flow; the client completes it when connecting (no secret is embedded in the configuration).
endpointNote: The endpoint is not published in this view yet; use the placeholder and update it when the server is available.
cursorNote: Paste the link in the browser or publish it as an "Add to Cursor" button; Cursor will open the server installation dialog.
claudeCodeNote: Save it as .mcp.json in the project root, or run: claude mcp add --transport http {slug} {endpoint}
claudeAiNote: In claude.ai open Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector and paste this remote server URL.
vscodeNote: Save it as .vscode/mcp.json in the project folder to register the server in VS Code.
playgroundDescription: Test a tool through the OAuth flow before connecting a client.
playgroundEmptyDescription: This server does not expose curated tools to invoke yet.
readOnlyNote: Read only according to the published definition.
argumentsHelp: Use a JSON object. Leave the object empty if the tool requires no arguments.
noEndpointDescription: The test area will be enabled when the MCP server has a published endpoint.
runtimeUnavailable: The Hosted MCP runtime is unavailable; invocation is disabled.
workspaceLoadingDescription: Resolving the active workspace before loading the MCP server.
loadingDescription: Loading the endpoint, active version and curated tools.
workspaceDescription: MCP server details and the test area load for the active workspace. Select a workspace to continue.
workspaceDenied: Your current role cannot create workspaces. Ask an administrator to create one or grant you access.
workspaceErrorDescription: Could not load available workspaces. Try again.
noAccess: You do not have permission to access this MCP server
noAccessDescription: Ask a workspace administrator for access.
notFoundDescription: The requested MCP server was not found in this workspace.
snippetsDescription: Client-generated examples based on the visible context of the active resource.
clipboardUnavailable: Your browser does not expose the Clipboard API here; select and copy the block manually.

errors.401: Your session expired or is invalid. Sign in again.
errors.409: The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.
errors.429: The request limit was reached; try again in a few moments.
